Hero.headline: Real technology skills, built step by step.
Hero.description: AfghanUstad helps you learn computers and technology through hands-on practice, so every lesson turns into a skill you can use.

learn.title: Learn
learn.text: Start with clear lessons and solid foundations.

practice.title: Practice
practice.text: Apply each idea through hands-on exercises.

build.title: Build skills
build.text: Turn practice into abilities you can rely on.

progress.title: Progress
progress.text: Move forward with confidence, one step at a time.

valueProposition.heading: Skills grow by doing, not only by watching.
valueProposition.intro: AfghanUstad is built around a simple loop: understand an idea, try it yourself, use it on something real, and see how far you have come.
valueProposition.note: Learning takes time and effort. AfghanUstad gives you a clear structure to build on.
valueProposition.exampleTitle: Build a monthly budget in a spreadsheet

learn.label: Learn
learn.title: Understand the idea clearly
learn.description: Short, focused lessons in your own language explain one concept at a time, so you know what you are doing and why.
learn.example: See what a formula does and why it is useful.

practice.label: Practice
practice.title: Build skill with hands-on practice
practice.description: Exercises let you repeat, make mistakes and correct them before you move on to the next step.
practice.example: Solve short exercises until entering formulas feels natural.

apply.label: Apply
apply.title: Use it on real tasks
apply.description: Small projects connect each lesson to tasks you may meet outside the course.
apply.example: Build a real monthly budget you can keep using.

progress.label: Progress
progress.title: See how far you have come
progress.description: Clear milestones show what you have finished and what comes next, at a pace that suits you.
progress.example: Review what you completed, then move on to the next lesson.

about.heading: Technology skills, taught in the language you think in.

story.p1: AfghanUstad is a learning platform for computer and technology skills, built for Afghan learners. Every lesson is explained in clear, familiar language, so the idea comes first and the jargon follows.
story.p2: We pair each concept with hands-on practice and real projects. Learners don't just watch: they try, make mistakes, and build confidence step by step.

about.quote: Understand it. Practice it. Build with it.

language.title: Your language comes first
language.description: Lessons in English, Dari, and Pashto, so language is never the barrier to learning technology.

understanding.title: Understanding before memorizing
understanding.description: We explain the why behind each idea, so skills carry over beyond a single tutorial.

practice.title: Practice is the lesson
practice.description: Exercises sit inside every topic, not after it, so knowledge turns into ability.

everyone.title: Room for every beginner
everyone.description: Clear starting points and small steps make it possible to begin from zero.

visual.ariaLabel: An abstract learning path rising through a geometric pattern, beside a card showing one lesson in three languages.

FinalCTA.title: Your next step starts here.
FinalCTA.description: Choose a course, ask us a question, or take the first step toward real technology skills. Learning starts with a single decision.
FinalCTA.note: Not sure where to begin? Browse the courses first, or get in touch and we will help you find the right place to start.

Footer.tagline: Practical computer and technology education, one step at a time.
